lines.text: I went to a book club yesterday. We read a short story and talked about it.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: That sounds interesting. Do I need to read the story before I go?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: No, they give you a copy when you arrive. We read it there together.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: I would like to try it because I want to read more in English. When is it?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Next Thursday at seven. The front door is locked after the meeting starts.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: I can get there at six fifty. Which door should I use then?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Use the front door. I need to leave now, but I can meet you there.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Great, see you at the front door on Thursday at six fifty.
lines.speaker: Eli
